proposal.reason: Primary change is a new host one-sided RMA feature set (pcclPutSignal/pcclSignal/pcclWaitSignal plus new src/rma/* subsystem) that is outside explicit catalog scopes, so use other. Add enqueue for substantive new RMA task creation/scheduling/plan lifecycle wiring; copy-engine for the CE-based in-node RMA put/wait execution path and signal synchronization; gin for the cross-node GIN proxy/plugin/context/progress and RMA registration path; communicator for numRmaCtx config, communicator capability negotiation/reporting, and init/finalize/async-error lifecycle integration; profiler for new RMA API event schema/mask/start-stop handling.
